method: Numbered paragraph correspondence, source heading positions and per-note marker/reference audit. This records structural correspondence, not identical translated wording or semantic certification.
differences: Paragraph source numbers 1–245 correspond one-to-one to stable p001–p245. Each edition independently contains note labels 1–224; note correspondence is recorded explicitly, without copying text or offsets.
The opening introduction heading is included as local h000; English structure begins at its first internal heading and omits this opening heading. Local heading IDs belong to this edition.

Date, signature, separators, abstract and table-of-contents text are inventoried ancillary material. The entire numbered closing/devotional text stays in its source paragraph; no prayers are removed from the original corpus.
